before.requirement: Allow cJSON_Minify to remove a whole-input single-line comment, producing an empty string.
before.reason: Minify handles the comment, while parse_value has no value case for the comment-only input. The harness returns on parse failure before calling Minify.

after.requirement: Allow cJSON_Minify to remove a whole-input single-line comment, producing an empty string.
after.reason: The minification contract and the harness's parse-success gate remain the same.

claims.reason: Both versions support the same Minify behavior, and the same old harness blocks it at the parse-success check.

missing_information: The delegated OSS-Fuzz build script is needed to establish the target's complete build configuration and call path.
